description: Savras tells each session about the repository's board: as it starts, that there is one, its own name on it and who else is working here; each turn, what they said and who was renamed. Silent where there is no board, and where svr is not installed.

hooks.command: command -v svr >/dev/null 2>&1 && svr board hello --hook || true
command -v svr >/dev/null 2>&1 && svr board unread --hook || true
